title.zh-CN: 乌镇 · VR 文旅体验

description.zh-CN: 以乌镇与大运河文化为主题的多人 LBE VR 项目，结合 3DGS 场景重建、数字导览与染坊交互。
description.en: A multiplayer LBE VR project exploring Wuzhen and Grand Canal culture through 3DGS reconstruction, digital guides and a dyeing workshop.

contribution.zh-CN: 大空间部署、多人同步与性能优化
contribution.en: Venue deployment, multiplayer synchronization and performance optimization

description.zh-CN: 以梵高画作为背景的横版解谜游戏。玩家扮演信使，用颜料绘制攀爬路径，将写给提奥的信送往邮箱。
description.en: A side-scrolling puzzle game set within Van Gogh’s paintings. A messenger paints climbable paths to deliver a letter to Theo.

contribution.zh-CN: 角色风格化 Shader 与全屏视觉效果
contribution.en: Character shaders and full-screen visual effects

description.zh-CN: 一款虚拟现实竞速游戏，玩家驾驶飞船穿行于不同赛道，体验 VR 环境下的驾驶与操控。
description.en: A virtual reality racing game in which players pilot a spaceship through different tracks, exploring driving and controls in VR.
